name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A standard mutual NDA created by a committee of over 40 attorneys representing technology vendors, procurement teams, boutique firms, and Big Law. Covers mutual confidentiality obligations for both parties.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: The cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, used to specify the business-specific terms that are incorporated by reference into the standard Mutual NDA terms.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products. Created by a committee of over 40 attorneys and covers subscription terms, order forms, and standard legal protections for cloud services.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: A standard agreement for design partner arrangements, enabling early-stage collaboration between a vendor and a prospective customer who provides feedback and testing in exchange for early access to a product.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: A standard SLA intended to be used alongside the Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement. Defines uptime commitments, remedies for downtime, and measurement methodology for cloud service performance guarantees.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: A standard agreement for professional services engagements, covering SOW terms, deliverables, payment, intellectual property ownership, and standard legal protections for service providers and clients.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A standard DPA that governs the processing of personal data by a vendor on behalf of a customer. Addresses GDPR, CCPA, and other data protection requirements, including sub-processor obligations and data transfer mechanisms.

name: Software License Agreement
description: A standard agreement for licensing software to customers, covering license grants, restrictions, order form terms, maintenance and support, and standard legal protections for on-premise or hybrid software deployments.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A standard agreement for formalizing partnership arrangements between companies, covering referral or reseller relationships, revenue sharing, intellectual property, and co-marketing obligations.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A standard short-term agreement for product or service pilots and trials. Allows a prospective customer to evaluate a product before committing to a full commercial agreement such as a CSA or Software License Agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A standard BAA required under HIPAA when a vendor handles protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity or another business associate. Covers permitted uses, safeguards, and breach notification obligations.

name: AI Addendum
description: A standard addendum to be used alongside a primary agreement (such as a CSA or Software License Agreement) when AI or machine learning features are involved. Addresses AI-specific concerns such as data use for model training, output limitations, and responsible AI obligations.
